truths.truth: A fresh store keeps each session as block rows: sessions holds only session_key and session_no, blocks holds one row per 64 KB block keyed (session_no, block_no) with bytes and a 32-byte hash, session_meta records block_size, and meta.archive_format is 2; a search over it returns the session's turns.
truths.evidence: crates/terminus-core/src/store/schema.rs:66-69 (sessions, two columns), :85-91 (blocks, PRIMARY KEY (session_no, block_no)), :103 (session_meta.block_size), :372-375 (blocks in TABLES, not DERIVED_TABLES); crates/terminus-core/src/store/open.rs:22 (ARCHIVE_FORMAT = 2); ingest cuts a new session at BLOCK_SIZE (crates/terminus-core/src/ingest/mod.rs:361-363). Spot-check with target/debug/terminus at HEAD against an empty scratchpad TERMINUS_DATA_DIR (HOME isolated): `terminus ingest` exit 0; sqlite3 -readonly read archive_format=2, uncompressed_len 206282, block_size 65536, 4 rows (ceil(206282/65536)=4), every hash 32 bytes, PRAGMA table_info(sessions) = session_key, session_no only; `terminus search "spans four blocks"` from the session's cwd printed 1 hit with its excerpt, and `search --json large` returned turn_id 1 with excerpt "that was a large one".

truths.truth: An append to a session of three or more blocks writes new rows and rewrites at most the last existing row; every other row is byte-identical; the pass fetches at most the tail row's bytes per walked file (all rows only for a session flagged diverged).
truths.evidence: crates/terminus-core/src/blob/block.rs:119-203 (append checks hash list against checksum and tail against its hash, then cuts from block `complete`, so only the tail and new blocks are returned); crates/terminus-core/src/store/archive.rs:297-316 (non-diverged append_state selects block_no, hash for all rows and bytes of at most the tail row; rows_read = 0 or 1), :275-294 (every row only when every_row/diverged); :321-336 (write upserts only the blocks given); crates/terminus-core/src/ingest/mod.rs:952 (Existing::read calls append_state with `diverged`), :393 (Pass.block_rows_read), :503 (archive::write in the file's one transaction); every walk reaches Existing::read (ingest/mod.rs:164, ingest/backfill.rs:402). Test crates/terminus-core/tests/compaction.rs:409 an_append_rewrites_at_most_the_tail_row_and_reads_no_other passed in the full suite: asserts >=3 rows before, rows before the old last byte-identical, the old last changed exactly when the stream ended mid-block, new rows numbered on, block_rows_read <= 1, verify clean. Codec tests a_block_append_onto_a_boundary_recompresses_nothing and a_block_append_crossing_a_boundary_redoes_only_the_tail passed.

truths.truth: Reading one turn through the excerpt, get, context and brief readers fetches only the block rows the turn's stream_offset and byte_len cover, counted by Reads.block_rows, and decompresses only those.
truths.evidence: All four readers go through crates/terminus-core/src/store/archive.rs:39-139 `ranges`, which selects rows only inside the merged covering spans (:85-100) and reports rows_fetched = rows.len() and blocks_decompressed (:134-138): recall/excerpt.rs:115-118, recall/get.rs:221-224, recall/context.rs:250-253, inject/brief.rs:559-562; Reads.block_rows at recall/excerpt.rs:57,64. The brief's test entry point session_start_reads (inject/brief.rs:99-114, cfg testkit) calls the same `render` the hook's session_start uses (:72-91). Tests passed in the full suite, each asserting block_rows == blocks_decompressed == testkit::covered_blocks (an independent offset/block_size computation, testkit.rs:613-632) on a session of >=3 rows: crates/terminus-core/tests/recall.rs:1266 an_excerpt_of_a_turn_inside_one_block_reads_one_row, :1285 an_excerpt_of_a_turn_spanning_k_blocks_reads_k_rows, :1366 a_context_window_of_a_turn_inside_one_block_reads_one_row, :1383 a_context_window_spanning_k_blocks_reads_k_rows, :2161 a_get_of_a_turn_inside_one_block_reads_one_row, :2177 a_get_of_a_turn_spanning_k_blocks_reads_k_rows; crates/terminus-core/tests/inject_brief.rs:258 the_brief_reads_only_the_row_its_two_quotes_sit_in, :289 the_brief_reads_the_union_of_the_rows_its_quotes_cover. `grep reads.blobs|pub blobs` finds nothing.

truths.truth: terminus verify names the session key and block number, in its text line and in a --json block field, for a changed block and for a block row deleted from the middle; a checksum that no longer matches the hashes is named with block null; every other session passes.
truths.evidence: crates/terminus-core/src/verify.rs:178-241 (numbering, per-block decode and hash, session checksum over stored hashes; block-level failures carry Some(block_no), checksum None), :78-90 (render `<key>: block N: `); crates/terminus/src/cmd/verify.rs:26-40 (`block: failure.block` in --json). Tests passed in the full suite: crates/terminus-core/tests/verify.rs:440 a_changed_byte_in_a_middle_block_names_that_block_and_no_other_session, :462 a_deleted_middle_row_names_that_block_and_no_other_session, :495 an_altered_checksum_names_the_session_and_no_block (each over 4 sessions, asserting no other key appears); crates/terminus/tests/cli.rs:726 verify_names_the_damaged_block_in_text_and_json (changed byte: text `<key>: block 1: `, --json block 1; checksum: block null). The deleted-row --json case has no named CLI test, so it was spot-checked: in a scratchpad store with session-large-record (4 rows) and session-basic, `DELETE FROM blocks WHERE block_no=1` on the large session, then `terminus verify` exit 1 printed `<large key>: block 1: row is missing` plus a session-level checksum line, `2 session(s) checked, 1 failed`; `verify --json` gave failures [{block: 1}, {block: null}], both for the large key only. Before damage the same store verified `2 session(s) checked, 0 failed`, exit 0.

truths.truth: Every command that opens the store refuses a format-1 store with a non-zero exit and the clean-install steps, leaving the database and WAL byte-identical and creating no blocks table; hook still exits 0 and mcp answers with a reason.

truths.truth: On a format-2 store reindex gives the same query results, export writes each full-mode session byte-identical to its transcript with archive_format 2 in the manifest, usage archive bytes equal the sum of block row lengths, and cargo test --workspace --all-features passes including the crash harness at 20+ kill points.

human_checks.name: Clean install on the owner's machine
human_checks.expected: On the owner's machine: `terminus verify` exits 0 and prints "N session(s) checked, 0 failed"; `sqlite3 -readonly ~/.local/share/terminus/terminus.db "SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key='archive_format'"` prints 2; N equals the count of transcripts still on disk on the install day (SUMMARY reports 1953); ~/terminus-format1/data still holds the old format-1 terminus.db. The 2026-10-05 format-1 binary was not saved, which the owner already accepted (SUMMARY deviation).
human_checks.why_human: Out-of-reach resource: it needs the owner's real store and the moved-aside folder (~/.local/share/terminus, ~/terminus-format1), which this verification was told not to touch, and the move it checks is a one-time, irreversible step already taken on that machine. No probe in the repository can reproduce it.
